scenario: Reroute a contract remediation task only after the request ticket, contract attachment, vendor rule, change log, prior review, and contact records all align on the same legal-ops lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the contract routing correction for request TCK-844. Start from the internal request ticket, the attached contract text CT-844, the vendor handling rule, and the change log note. Then use the prior review note, the task record, and the current contact records to move only the affected routing task into its proper legal-ops handoff state.

office_tasks.title: Contract routing correction for district rollout
office_tasks.description: Correct the routing lane for request TCK-844 once legal-ops handoff is confirmed.

office_vendor_handling_rules.body_text: Vendor handling rule VR-844. If the contract amendment changes signature routing to legal-ops, the remediation task must move to assignee legal.ops@example.com and status waiting_legal_ops.

office_change_log_notes.body_text: Change log CL-844. Amendment rev-3 removed vendor-side routing and redirected the approval lane to Legal Ops Queue.

office_prior_review_notes.body_text: Prior review note PR-844. Hold TASK-844 in vendor triage only until rev-3 is confirmed. After that, reassign to Legal Ops Queue and mark waiting_legal_ops.

office_contract_attachment_texts.body_text: Contract attachment CT-844. Amendment rev-3 states that final review and routing now belong to Legal Ops Queue, not the vendor liaison queue.

office_internal_request_tickets.body_text: Internal request ticket TCK-844. Correct the routing task TASK-844 once the contract amendment, rule, and review notes all align on the legal-ops lane. Do not close the task; move it into the legal-ops handoff state.

office_recent_interactions.summary: Legal Ops Queue acknowledged readiness to take the routing correction after rev-3 is confirmed.
